excerpt.zh: 一颗小型卫星正环绕这颗气态巨行星运行，这颗小卫星可能蕴藏大量矿藏。需要进行一次彻底的调查，对开采行动的可能性进行研究。
excerpt.en: One of the small moonlets orbiting this gas giant has been identified as a promising mining site. A more thorough survey will have to be conducted to determine whether a mining operation would be feasible or not.

texts.zh: 在对[From.GetName]气态巨行星的众多自然卫星进行更为详尽的勘测后，我们发现了初步勘测时忽略的带有一座贵金属矿藏的卫星。虽然该卫星体型微小，但其环绕母星运转的轨道稳定，而且这颗小卫星的地质构造本身也很稳定。
texts.en: A more detailed scan of one of the many natural satellites orbiting the gas giant [From.GetName] has revealed a deposit of precious metals and minerals that was overlooked in the initial survey. Although the moon is very small, it has a stable orbit around its primary and appears tectonically stable.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]是一颗独特的气态巨行星。我们对天体物理的知识告诉我们，这样的行星应该有一个行星环，然而它并没有。在我们的科研船近距离观察了那颗诡异的卫星之后，这一现象的原因已经十分显然了。这颗星球被一些“牧羊人”卫星所环绕，这些卫星全部拥有富得难以置信的矿物，并且每年还在积累更多。我们可以用精准控制的爆炸爆破这些卫星，然后将它们的矿物一次性收集起来；也可以让它们继续留在环带，持续地收集它们积累下来的太空残骸。
texts.en: [From.GetName] is a peculiar gas giant. Our knowledge of astrophysics tells us that the planet should have a planetary ring, yet it doesn't. The cause of this became apparent after our science ship took a closer look at the intriguing moon. The planet is surrounded by shepherd moons, all incredibly rich in minerals and accumulating more every year. We could blast the moons with precise and controlled explosions and harvest them or keep them inside the ring zone and harvest the space debris they accrue.

label.zh: 我们现在就需要那些矿物。

label.en: Good things come to those who wait.

summary.text:
# 潜力巨大的卫星 / Promising Moon

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:229; events/anomaly_events_1.txt:4181 (anomaly.340); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:2814 (anomaly.6840)

## 如何开始 How it starts

没有战略资源的气态巨行星可能生成（1级，权重3，全局一次 max_once）。

Can spawn on a gas giant without a strategic resource (level 1, weight 3, once per game via max_once).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

anomaly.340“珍宝卫星”（能量矿藏 d_energy_3 + precious_moon 修正）权重1；anomaly.6840“羊羊太少”基础权重0，仅当气态巨行星没有光环时 +10：选项a获得1200矿物并给行星添加光环；选项b改为 d_minerals_5 矿藏。

anomaly.340 "Precious Moon" (d_energy_3 deposit plus precious_moon modifier) has weight 1; anomaly.6840 "Too Few Sheep" has base weight 0 and +10 only if the gas giant has no ring: option a gives 1200 minerals and adds a ring; option b gives a d_minerals_5 deposit instead.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

两个结果互斥：有光环的巨行星只会得到 340；无光环时约 10/11 概率得到 6840、1/11 得到 340。

The results are exclusive: a ringed giant always gets 340; without a ring 6840 is about 10/11 and 340 about 1/11.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

anomaly.340 的图片随生物舰船帝国变化。

anomaly.340's picture changes for bio-ship empires.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对。草稿把 anomaly.6840 显示为 p=0.00*（基础权重），实际是按有无光环 +10 的权重，已用互斥组说明。

Checked. The draft shows anomaly.6840 as p=0.00* (its base weight); the real weight is +10 depending on the ring, documented with an exclusive group.
